description.name: Aurora Cabin
description.headline: Modern cabin under northern skies
description.description: A modern timber cabin outside Rovaniemi, built for winter: floor heating throughout, a private sauna, and a covered charging spot for electric cars. Big windows face north for aurora watching.

reviews: The sauna after a day in the snow was unbeatable. Cabin was warm and spotless.
EV charging on site made our winter road trip easy. Kids loved the PlayStation.

policies.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 21 days before check-in
policies.payment_schedule: 25% deposit at booking, balance due 30 days before arrival
